title: CROUCH STILL TO CREEP BACK HEALTH
why: His note of 2026-10-13: crouching and sitting still should very slowly regain health. Crouch and keep still for 3 seconds, with no hit taken in the last 6, and you now creep back one point of health every 2 seconds, with the RECOVERING mark lit. It stops at 85, the same ceiling as a Bandage, so a Medkit is still the only way back to 100, and above 85 it does nothing. Moving, firing, rolling, standing up or taking a hit stops it and the 3 second wait starts over. While it runs it takes the place of the old slow creep (one point every 3 seconds after 10 quiet seconds, standing or crouched) so the two never add up; that old creep is unchanged for everyone who is not crouched and still. It works the same in the demo and the career, and in a second window your own health is carried to your teammate the way a heal is. Nothing random is drawn.
now: Crouch and keep still and your health slowly creeps back, up to 85.
